name: markdown-rs
description: The only Markdown editor you need.

scripts.check: svelte-kit sync && bun run check:types && bun run check:frontend && bun run check:backend
scripts.check:backend: cd src-tauri && cargo check && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.clean: rm -rf .svelte-kit build node_modules bun.lock src-tauri/gen src-tauri/target website/dist coverage .pkg/src .pkg/pkg .pkg/*.zst .pkg/*.gz
scripts.fix: bun run fix:frontend && bun run fix:backend
scripts.fix:backend: cd src-tauri && cargo clippy --fix --allow-dirty --all-targets --all-features && cargo fmt
scripts.package: bun run build && mkdir -p .pkg && cp PKGBUILD .pkg/ && cd .pkg && makepkg -si --noconfirm --force
scripts.test: echo "Running Tests..." && vitest run && cd src-tauri && cargo test
scripts.update: bun update --latest && cd src-tauri && cargo upgrade && cargo update --verbose
scripts.website: bunx --bun vite build --config website/vite.config.js && bun x serve website/dist
